geometry: Four60%extent crops, ownership by original-image quadrant center, finalIoU0.7 NMS. Entire process automatic.
selection: Whole-mode minimum validation countMAE (ties higher confidence) is baseline. Tiled candidate must lower countMAE by at least5%, keep precision and recall no more than2percentage-points below baseline, and keep F1 at least baseline. Choose minimumMAE eligible tile threshold; otherwise whole.
testPolicy: No model, threshold or pipeline changes using test outcomes. Primary choice fixed before first test prediction. Also evaluate whole-image reference if tile selected.
supersedes: First training protocol specified whole-image inference. This validation-only comparison is registered before opening test; the first protocol remains preserved.
